name: Seipora Mostana
role: Factor of House Mostana in Kharun
voice: Unhurried; offers candied dates; calls every deal a friendship and every threat a misunderstanding between friends.
backstory: The third daughter of a Calishite trading house, Seipora runs its warehouses on Brimstone Quay and its loans to every heir. She wants the brimstone monopoly and a prize big enough that her mother names her heir.
secrets: She holds the Saltwater Compact in her strongbox aboard the Sixth Daughter.
A syl-pasha in Calimshan will pay a fortune for the Heartcoal.
